name: Shooting Victims (2006-Present)
description: This dataset records individual shooting victims from 2006 to the present, with one row per victim. Each record includes an incident key linking victims to the same shooting event, a victim identifier, and demographic details: age group, sex, and race. A statistical murder flag indicates whether the victim's injury was classified as a homicide. The sample contains 5,000 rows across six columns. The data can support analyses of shooting victim demographics over time, comparisons of fatal and non-fatal shootings, and identification of incidents with multiple victims. It may be useful for public safety research, policy evaluation, and community reporting, though users should account for the sampled nature of the data and any reporting or classification practices behind the murder flag.
